headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Callahan's Passage As Stonecradle Front Erupts
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the frenzied island fighting across Fisherman's Row has subsided into quiet, while inland sectors have witnessed sharp tactical upheavals. Callahan's Passage remains a ferocious battleground with ongoing base turnovers at The Latch and The Procession, matched by persistent bloodshed across Weathered Expanse where Necropolis and Spirit Watch endure recurring assaults. Stonecradle has flared into violent life, sustaining over fourteen hundred combined casualties in the last two hours alongside fresh swings at The Long Fast. In the east, Stlican Shelf reports continuous friction with new events registered at The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch, while Oarbreaker logs maritime contention around Posterus. Meanwhile, combat in the Dead Lands, Marban Hollow, and Loch Mor has settled into heavy attritional slugfests without territorial exchanges over the recent two-hour span.
